answers.genPolicy:e5e76049de0091dd0f40c55e414a32:
[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
[B3] < deviceB | ... > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB
=> < deviceB | ... > $ deviceB 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (FreshSecret ; CurrentTime) .
[B3] < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : Tickets , ...) , ... > $ deviceB 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (Secret ; IssuedAt)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : (Tickets , (Secret , IssuedAt)) , ...) , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : (Tickets , (Secret , CurrentTime)) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'getKey' cloudA
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : (Tickets , (Secret , CurrentTime)) , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret) .
[B4] < UserX | 'knows' : Knowns , ... > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (Secret)
=> < UserX | 'knows' : (Knowns , Secret) , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : nils , 'tickets' : Tickets , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (Secret)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : UserX , 'tickets' : Tickets , ...) , ... > .
[B6] < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : Owner , 'owners' : Owners , 'tickets' : Tickets , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'join' cloudA | (Secret)
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('owner' : Owner , 'owners' : (Owners , UserX) , 'tickets' : Tickets , ...) , ... > .
[B7] < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : (Tickets , (Secret , IssuedAt)) , ...) , ... >
=> < cloudA | deviceB : ('tickets' : nils , ...) , ... > if CurrentTime - IssuedAt > 2 .
